import os, tempfile, pathlib
from tools import normalize, word_counts

p.write_bytes(
    "\ufeffa,1,x\r\n".encode("utf-8")
    + b"   \r\n"
    + b"\n"
    + b"   # indented comment\n"
    + b"b,2,\n"          # empty third field -> ignored by word_counts
    + b"c,3\n"           # short row -> ignored by word_counts
    + b"d,4, x \n"       # -> 'x' (strip)
    + b"e,5,#hash\n"     # '#' not at line start -> kept as data
    + b"f,6, \xc3\xa9t\xc3\xa9\n"  # unicode, no space handling issues
)
rows = normalize(str(p))
print("rows:", rows)
print("counts:", word_counts(rows))
